title: South Florida Friday Night Guide
igCaption:
Friday plans across South Florida, from yachts to gardens.
Oct. 16, South Florida, prices vary

Sources: NBC 6 South Florida, Secret Miami, Seminole Hard Rock Hollywood Poker, The Palm Beach Post, Local 10

#SouthFlorida #MiamiEvents #FortLauderdale #PalmBeach

scenes.text: Friday night in South Florida starts with yachts in Fort Lauderdale and ends with a cold front on the way.
Start in Fort Lauderdale. Yacht Rendezvous returns with luxury yachts, entertainment, and a cause.

scenes.text: In Pinecrest, NightGarden opens November 12 at Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden. It runs 60 minutes, welcomes all ages, and adds a new ice rink under the palms.
